evidence.why: Complete body contains GP-only attachment assertion and two sequential field assignments.
GP attachment performs the later hardware transfer.

facts.rationale: Corrects the unsupported atomic-update claim and distinguishes current GP detachment from a requirement that the object has never been attached.
facts.value: In assertion-enabled builds, rejects the currently GP-attached FIFO, thresholds not aligned to 32 bytes, a high threshold at or beyond top - base, and a low threshold not strictly below the high threshold. CPU-only attachment is not prohibited. The routine then stores hiWatermark and loWatermark sequentially, without interrupt exclusion or an atomic-pair guarantee; it does not modify cursors, occupancy, attachment state, or hardware registers. GXSetGPFifo subsequently transfers the stored thresholds into CP registers.

facts.rationale: Replaces an unsupported compiled-layout inference with the directly evidenced declarations and their build-conditional distinction.
facts.value: The source-level persistent FIFO state comprises separately declared struct __GXFifoObj pointers CPUFifo and GPFifo, OSThread pointer __GXCurrentThread, GXBool CPGPLinked, BOOL GXOverflowSuspendInProgress, GXBreakPtCallback BreakPointCB, u32 __GXOverflowCount, and void pointer __GXCurrentBP. DEBUG additionally declares int IsWGPipeRedirected. These declarations establish logical C types, not a single aggregate or compiled .sbss membership, ordering, padding, or uniform word-sized storage.
